item.title: Blue Archive 5th Anniversary Update Is Live Globally With 200 Free Recruitments and a 3★ Fest Choice Ticket
item.description:
The update is built around Gehenna’s Pandemonium Society on summer holiday: five students in swimsuits, a new event story aboard a ship and two Fest banners spread over the next two weeks. It also brings the recruitment changes that Nexon confirmed for the global version in September.
Each free pull also counts towards the banner’s Recruitment Mileage and adds one Unique Recruitment Charge. That Charge is the new part: every non-Pick-Up student pulled adds one, it carries over to the next Unique or Fest banner, and reaching certain amounts triggers a special recruitment.
Logging in before December 8 puts a Special 3★ Fest Student Choice Ticket in the mailbox. It lets each account pick one Fest student and must be used by December 15. The list is Wakamo, Hoshino (Swimsuit), Mika, Hanako (Swimsuit), Hina (Dress), Hoshino (Armed), Shiroko*Terror, Neru (School), Mika (Swimsuit), Aris (Armed) and Kei as Strikers, plus Rio and Nagisa (Swimsuit) as Specials. Picking a student you already own gives 50 Eligma and 100 of her Eleph instead.
All five new students are Gehenna’s Pandemonium Society in swimsuits. Makoto (Swimsuit), a Mystic Striker, and Satsuki (Swimsuit), a Sonic Striker, share the first Unique Pick-Up banner, which runs until November 17.
From November 17 to November 24 comes the Fest Recruitment with Iroha (Swimsuit), an Explosive Striker, and Ibuki (Swimsuit), an Explosive Special, alongside the returning Rio and Neru (School). During a Fest banner the 3★ rate doubles from 3% to 6%. The fifth student, Chiaki (Swimsuit), is a 1★ Piercing Special earned from the event.
The update opens Main Story Act 2, Volume 1: “Flame and Shadow” with its first two chapters, “Glory to Gehenna!” and “As We Become the Flame”, which come with Korean dubbing. A digest of Act 1 was added for players who want to catch up first.
The event story, “Set Sail! Pandemonium Ship: Chair Makoto’s Lux Summer Getaway!”, runs until November 24, and a mini story, “Ibuki Runaway Incident”, follows on November 17. The update also adds Shinon’s Battle Pass, a new furniture set and a Total Assault against Hieronymus (Urban Warfare) from November 17. Nexon walked through all of it in its November Schale News broadcast:
The full schedule, with every banner and event date, is in the official 11/10 patch notes. The free recruitments end first, on November 17, so they are the part of the Blue Archive 5th anniversary to claim before anything else.

item.title: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle Is Coming to Mobile in 2027, With a Closed Beta in December
item.description:
Square Enix has announced Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle, a new turn-based Dragon Quest for iOS and Android planned for a worldwide simultaneous release in 2027. Sign-ups for the first Dragon Quest RPG closed beta are already open, with 25,000 spots and testing from December 8 to December 15.
The game is being developed by WFS (Wright Flyer Studios), the studio behind Another Eden and Heaven Burns Red, with Square Enix handling planning and production. It will be free to play with in-app purchases, and it launches with text in English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Korean. New party members are recruited through gacha, the biggest break from how the mainline games handle a growing party.
The story opens high above the world on the floating isle of Monbelusha, in the middle of the yearly Ringing Feast. During the prayers, the fiend Zaahl corrupts Yggdrasil, the island’s symbol of hope, and turns it into Grimvein, a cursed tree whose influence spreads despair across the land.
As Monbelusha falls apart, a boy drops towards the world below. The goddess Belusha hands him a mysterious branch, and he becomes the Warden of the World Tree, setting out to save the world aboard the isle of the chosen. The announcement trailer shows that fall, the corrupted tree hanging over the fields and the first party members joining the hero.
Combat keeps the series’ command-based formula: a party of four picks actions each turn, and monsters can fight alongside the team. On top of the usual spells and attacks, the game adds Fast Strike skills and pep powers, plus follow-up attacks that chain off a partner’s move. The battle screen also offers Normal and Auto modes and a Tactics setting.
The footage shows new characters next to familiar faces from earlier games, such as Pierre the slime knight. Exploration uses a top-down view, from open fields down to dungeon floors, and every trip brings back materials for the hero’s home.
That home is the base, the second half of the loop. Players craft and upgrade equipment there, put up new buildings and talk with the monsters that have settled in. Each improvement strengthens the party and opens up new places to explore, so the adventure and the base grow together.
Applications are open on the official closed beta page until November 23, 2026 at 2:59 PM UTC. If more people apply than there are spots, testers are picked by lottery, and results go out by email on December 4 (UTC). Exact start and end times for the test will be posted on the game’s official X and Facebook accounts.
Progress from the beta will not carry over to the full release. These are the device requirements for the test:
Square Enix notes that the requirements may change by launch. More details on the story and systems are on the official website.

item.title: MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE Mobile Opens Pre-Registration With Up to 200 Roll Tickets
item.description:
MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE is coming to phones. Bandai Namco announced MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE Mobile for iOS and Android on November 8 and opened pre-registration the same day, with a reward campaign that can hand every player up to 200 Roll Tickets and four commemorative costumes at launch.
The mobile version keeps the format of the console game, a 24-player battle royale in which eight teams of three fight on a shrinking map until only one team is left. It is free to download with in-app purchases, and it has no release date yet.
MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE launched in 2023 on PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch as the first free-to-play online battle game based on Kohei Horikoshi’s manga. Players pick a hero or a villain, team up in trios and use each character’s Quirk to fight the other squads and survive.
On mobile, Bandai Namco has reworked three things. Each Quirk skill fires with a single tap, matches are shorter than on console so a round fits in a break, and mobile players are only matched against other mobile players.
The teaser trailer shows the same arenas and characters as the console game, with the tap controls in place:
The most important detail for current players is on the official specification sheet: the mobile game has no cross-play and no cross-progression with the PC and console versions. Characters, costumes and anything bought on console stay there, and everyone starts from zero on the phone.
The roster, on the other hand, does not start from zero. Every character already available on console will be playable on mobile from launch, and Bandai Namco says new characters will be added to the mobile game at the same time as they debut on console. The console version is currently in its 19th season.
The official pre-registration campaign unlocks rewards as the total count grows. The figure combines sign-ups from every store worldwide, and the rewards are sent after the game launches:
If every tier is reached, that adds up to 200 Roll Tickets, the tickets spent on the game’s random draws. The costumes celebrate the manga passing 100 million copies in circulation.
Pre-registration is open on the official website, the App Store and Google Play, with separate store pages for the English and Japanese versions. Bandai Namco has not yet published the full list of countries where the game will be available.
MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE Mobile pre-registration arrives after the series lost one mobile game and gained another. My Hero Academia: Ultra Impact closed its global version, while KLab’s My Hero Academia UNITED SURVIVAL is already out on iOS, Android and PC. ULTRA RUMBLE Mobile is the first of the three built around player-versus-player matches.
Bandai Namco has not said when the mobile version will launch. The release date, the final region list and the in-game shop are still to be announced.

item.title: Zenless Zone Zero 3.4: Robin and Kafka Get Their First Combat Trailer, Sunbringer Joins as the First Enchainer
item.description:
That makes three new Agents announced for the next version so far: the two crossover characters and one original. HoYoverse has not given a release date for Version 3.4 yet. The current version, 3.3 “Journey to the Sky”, launched on October 21.
The Zenless Zone Zero × Honkai: Star Rail crossover was first revealed on October 9, when the official Zenless Zone Zero account announced that “Kafka and Robin are coming to New Eridu” in Version 3.4.
Both are among the best-known characters in Honkai: Star Rail. Robin is the Halovian singer from Penacony, a 5-star Harmony character on the Star Rail side; Kafka is a member of the Stellaron Hunters and a 5-star Nihility character, and she has been part of Star Rail’s cast since its launch.
The video, titled Unidentified Transmission, gives each of them about half a minute of real gameplay in a large circular hall. Robin fights with a staff, calls down strikes of blue light on the enemies around her and ends her sequence rising above the arena on a pair of white wings. Kafka works at a distance with crimson threads that cut across the screen, then closes in for a finishing move with her coat thrown over her shoulders. Both sequences mix basic attacks, skills and a full-screen finisher.
What the trailer does not say is just as relevant for players planning their Polychromes. HoYoverse has not revealed the rank, Attribute or Specialty of either character, nor how they will be obtained. Those details normally arrive with the version’s Special Program.
The third Agent of the version was presented on October 24. In HoYoverse’s words, Sunbringer “will make her official debut in Zenless Zone Zero Version 3.4 as a brand-new Void Hunter and the first-ever Enchainer Agent”. Void Hunters are the elite Hollow specialists of New Eridu, and Enchainer is a new role that the game has not had before; HoYoverse has not yet explained how it works in combat.
Sunbringer belongs to Roscaelifer, and the name is a title more than a single person: her official Agent Record, published on October 23, presents three Sunbringers who swore to protect the city together, with the line “The lighthouse still stands, because we have stood shoulder to shoulder.” The same record includes messages from Claret and Remielle, two Agents already in the game, which ties her story to theirs.
Her Zenless Zone Zero 3.4 preview shows her with a long blade and a wide range of blue lightning attacks, cutting through enemies in a city street and closing a timed fight with a field of glowing cubes. Robin also appears beside her in one scene.
The collaboration goes both ways. On the Star Rail side, Ellen Joe and Astra Yao will board the Astral Express in Honkai: Star Rail 4.8, planned for winter 2026, as HoYoverse confirmed when it presented Zenless Zone Zero 3.3. The official Star Rail announcement adds that “there are more surprises in store”, so the exchange may not stop at two characters per game.
Until 3.4 arrives, the second half of Version 3.3 starts on November 11, with the Incarcerating Grip W-Engine Signal Search running until December 1 and Severian’s new outfit available the same day.

item.title: hololive Mahjong Launches November 25 in Japan, With Hands-On Events Before Release
item.description:
hololive Mahjong -Holojan- launches in Japan on November 25, 2026. COVER and Aiming revealed the hololive Mahjong release date during the game’s official livestream on November 4, the same day pre-registrations passed 300,000.
The game brings 37 hololive talents to the mahjong table on iOS, Android, Windows and web browsers. It is free to play with in-game purchases, and talents are pulled from a character banner using in-game coins.
Players in Japan can try the game early. From November 12 to November 20, 16 esports facilities across the country, from Sapporo to Naha, host free play sessions, and everyone who joins receives a serial code for an exclusive in-game title. The full list of venues is on the official announcement.
During the livestream, Aki Rosenthal, Hakui Koyori, Ichijou Ririka and Juufuutei Raden sat down for matches on the live build:
With 300,000 players signed up, all three rewards from the original pre-registration campaign are unlocked. The official campaign page now adds two more:
The game’s theme song, Kami Tsumo☆Dora Dora Densetsu (神ツモ☆ドラドラ伝説), came out on music streaming services on November 4, sung by Aki Rosenthal, Shirakami Fubuki, Houshou Marine and Ichijou Ririka. A set of 40 official LINE stamps, including the in-game reactions and calls like “Ron!”, “Tsumo!” and “Riichi!”, goes on sale on November 19.

item.title: Honkai: Nexus Anima Launches in Spring 2027, Final Closed Beta Starts November 25
item.description:
Honkai: Nexus Anima, HoYoverse’s open-world creature-catching RPG, will launch in spring 2027. Before that, the studio is running one last test: the Final Closed Beta starts on November 25, 2026 on PC, Android and iOS, and sign-ups opened today.
Pre-registration for the full release is also open on the App Store.
Players apply by filling out the recruitment questionnaire on the official Honkai: Nexus Anima website. Slots are limited: HoYoverse will pick testers from the applicants and notify them through the eligibility checker, email and SMS. All progress is wiped when the test ends, and the exact schedule will be announced later.
The teaser for the test shows the cast running along the beach of the new area with their Anima.
Players start as an Animaster in the town of Iia, with new story chapters, new companions and new rivals. Iia itself is bigger this time, from a traditional bank and a high-rise office building to a lighthouse island.
HoYoverse is also adjusting the two banners, the Eidos Event Bond and the Anima Event Bond. The first 5-star Eidos or Anima a player gets is guaranteed to be the current limited one, and pulling the limited Eidos also unlocks its matching Anima Companion for free.
The gameplay showcase walks through the new content in action: exploring Iia, catching and raising Anima and fighting alongside them.
The game is still in development, so details can change before the spring 2027 release.

item.title: The Alchemist Code: Port Masters Launches in Japan With a Free UR Ouroboros and Three 10-Pull Tickets
item.description:
The Alchemist Code: Port Masters is out in Japan. K3 Studio launched the new mobile RPG on iOS and Android on November 4, 2026, and every player who logs in receives the full set of pre-registration rewards after sign-ups passed 100,000.
Port Masters is set in an alternate version of the world of The Alchemist Code (Tagatame), gumi’s tactics RPG whose original Japanese version closed in November 2024. It is free to play, with units obtained through summons.
Because the campaign reached its final milestone, the Port Masters launch comes with every reward unlocked:
Battles are played in portrait mode and built for speed. A team is made of five main units and two tactical units, and the result depends on how gear, tactics, buffs, debuffs and skill order are combined before the fight starts. Many skills from the original game return, along with special skill cut-ins.
The main multiplayer mode is the Port Battle, a real-time fight for up to 10 players where ports compete with each other using shared Force Skills.
The launch trailer is narrated by Natsuki Hanae, who voiced Logi in the original game, and Inori Minase, who played Kasumi in the animated film. It marks the 10th anniversary of The Alchemist Code and the 7th of the movie.
On X, the official account is running a giveaway until November 15, a character quiz until November 22 and a popularity vote from November 4 to 10. The game is available on the Japanese App Store and Google Play; there is no word on a release outside Japan. The full announcement is on the official press release, and our pre-registration coverage has the earlier details.

item.title: NIKKE PC Launcher Breach: Level Infinite Confirms Malware, Apologizes and Offers Compensation
item.description:
The incident only involves the Windows PC launcher of GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE, developed by SHIFT UP and published worldwide by Level Infinite. The publisher says the version of the launcher currently being distributed is safe to use.
According to the official notice, a domain used by part of the game’s services was taken over by a third party. From there, the attack unfolded in several steps:
【PC Launcher Security Incident and Follow-Up Measures】 We have identified that some files in the NIKKE Windows PC launcher were recently tampered with by a third party, potentially allowing malicious programs to run when the launcher was launched.
— GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE (@NIKKE_en) November 5, 2026
Every player who opened the Windows launcher at least once after September 27 at 15:41 (UTC+9) is asked to check the security of both their PC and their accounts. The team has published a manual security check guide on its official channels with the steps to follow.
The notice warns that the risk goes beyond the game: accounts on other services and personal assets may also be affected. Players who notice anything unusual on their accounts, or who have suffered a financial loss, should contact NIKKE Customer Support.
In its apology, the NIKKE Operations Team says it takes full responsibility for failing to provide a secure service, and that an official program meant for playing the game “should never become a threat” to players’ safety. As a token of apology, all Commanders will receive in-game compensation. The notice does not list the items.
The incident lands in the middle of the game’s 4th anniversary, with the MARIA-n story event running and the Scarlet: Goddeath pick-up recruitment live since November 5.
